# Attributes
This feature is: [color=orange]In-Progress[/color].
Attributes are not skills. Let's get this out of the way first. Rather, they define who you--as a character--are, and eventually, strive to be.
They provide benefits in various activities, so you can have freedom of expressing the "path" you choose.
The number one mission of Oathlord's attribute system is to stop players from focusing on attributes. Really. And to do that, the aim is to have everyone be equal at any moment, regarding attributes, with rare exceptions (you never know what happens in a world like this).
This, in turn, means that you won't get better at strength by punching things. Instead, as the round (and time) goes by, you will be given points to invest at certain moments.
## How to invest
Simply press the keybind (by default 'O'), or click the button at the top bar. It should have a "gate" with pillars as an icon.
On that screen, you will be able to see how many points you currently own, information about the attributes, and a button next to each attribute which allows you to increase them.
If you have enough points, you can press the button on the right of an attribute of your choosing to increase it's current points. Each attribute has a maximum of points it can reach, and it will be indicated by having the "MAX" label on it, instead of a plain number.
When you are ready to apply your points, press "Resolve" at the bottom. You'll get a popup on your character that the process was successful.
No, you can not undo the points you spend on attributes, so be careful. Unless...
